sup:70410.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a volume of 19890 pcs per year at a price of €32.20 per unit. The requested contract term is 12 months, and our Lieferzeit is 54 days. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We look forward to proceeding according to our standard commercial procedure upon receipt of your confirmation.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

move.body:
Thank you for your offer. We have moved on our side; please see our updated terms.

To support the price in our term sheet:
Our should-cost estimate for this part is EUR 24.31 per unit, before any margin (cost:340010).
Labour cost index DE, manufacturing changed +2.7% from 2025-06 to 2026-06 (idx:LCI-C@2025-06, idx:LCI-C@2026-06).
To support the volume and contract length we propose:
Our forecast for this part shows a recorded change of +10.1% (fc:340010@2026-09).
Could you lift your allocation to 22230 units per year?
Could you send us a breakdown of the costs behind your price?

Dear Sir or Madam,
We acknowledge receipt of your message.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €31.70 per unit, Lieferzeit 56 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, a contract term of 24 months.
Please note:
Your figures confirm our case: that driver rose.
We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation.
We checked the should cost data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
We can accommodate the requested volume of 23,400 units over a 24-month term with a 56-day lead time.
Your should-cost estimate does not reflect the specialized nature of our manufacturing.
We revise our offer to €31.70 per unit for this package.
Our calculation is our property; we do not share a breakdown.
We will process your next message according to our standard procedure.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

Dear Sir or Madam,
We acknowledge receipt of your message.
This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide.
Our terms: a price of €31.60 per unit, Lieferzeit 56 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, a contract term of 24 months.
For the record:
We received a lot of material; we looked at what bears on this part.
We checked the price history data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation.
We checked the news data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation.
We verified your past order prices and delivery records; they hold, but do not affect our calculation.
We can accommodate your request for a 36-month contract term.
In exchange for this extended commitment, we revise our price to €31.60 per unit.
Alternatively, with a contract term of 36 months: €31.60 per unit.
Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal.
Our Lieferzeit is 56 days.
These are our standard conditions for this product.
We will process your next message according to our standard procedure.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We received a lot of material; we looked at what bears on this part. We checked the price history data, the news data, and your past order prices and delivery records as cited; they all hold, but do not affect our calculation. Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal.

This is our neues Angebot. Our main Angebot provides a price of €31.60 per unit, Lieferzeit 56 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, and a contract term of 24 months. 

We can accommodate your request for a 36-month contract term. In exchange for this extended commitment, we revise our price to €31.60 per unit. Alternatively, with a contract term of 36 months: a price of €31.60 per unit, Lieferzeit 56 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, and a contract term of 36 months. 

This is our letztes Angebot. Please decide. This offer stays valid for 7 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
